status: Locally specified candidate methodology; not externally preregistered, not human-audited, and not a completed final evaluation.
scope: English public-web-style prose with documented origin, licensed or consented reuse, and independently rated quality. A stratified curated benchmark is not a probability sample of the internet.
feature_choice: Original ten-feature model fixed for the confirmatory comparison; pilot ablations are exploratory, not evidence of a superior selected model.
threshold_method: Negative-only Neyman-Pearson order statistic, with the scoring model fixed before independent calibration. One eligible negative selected per leakage cluster by ascending document ID, independent of scores.
threshold_ties: Use next representable float above the selected negative score; prediction uses score >= threshold.
calibration_assumptions: Negative representatives must be independent and exchangeable with future negatives for the conditional bound to apply. Sampling one per cluster is not proof of independence or transportability.
uncertainty: Percentile bootstrap of leakage clusters conditional on fixed predictions; exact binomial intervals separately labeled as requiring independence. Report valid replicate counts and boundary degeneracy. No pooling of raw scores from different fitted models.
final_access: An independent custodian supplies a hash commitment before final evaluation; developers do not inspect final text or labels before model freezing. Local assertions and hashes cannot establish genuine blinding.
operational_scope: Manual-review research only; no automatic removal, misconduct accusations, or public labels.
prevalence: Not estimated from the balanced benchmark. Requires a separate probability sample, audited joint-screen errors, transportability evidence, and uncertainty propagation; unavailable in this cycle.
change_policy: Any post-freeze change to code, rubric, features, threshold rule, data, or primary metrics requires a new protocol version and a new untouched final set. Old pilot and inspected final samples remain development material.
